  {"step":2,"file":"src/libzscanner/scanner.c.t0","function":"<global>","line":8793,"var":"s->svcb.params_position","code":"s->svcb.params_position = rdata_tail;","note":"When the SVCB RDATA parser reaches the parameter section, it records the start of the parameter block for later validation."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/libzscanner/scanner.c.t0","function":"<global>","line":8820,"var":"s->svcb.param_position","code":"s->svcb.param_position = rdata_tail;","note":"Each parsed parameter updates the current parameter pointer, which is then passed to the sorting helper."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/libzscanner/functions.c","function":"svcb_sort","line":868,"var":"curr_pos","code":"uint8_t *curr_pos = svcb->param_position;","note":"The sorter uses the current parameter pointer as the source of the parameter being inserted into the already-parsed list."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/libzscanner/functions.c","function":"svcb_sort","line":874,"var":"scanner->buffer","code":"memcpy(scanner->buffer, curr_pos, curr_full_len);","note":"If the current key must be inserted earlier, the code copies the current parameter into a fixed-size scanner buffer before shifting the existing parameter bytes."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/libzscanner/functions.c","function":"svcb_sort","line":875,"var":"param_pos","code":"memmove(param_pos + curr_full_len, param_pos, curr_pos - param_pos);","note":"The existing parameter bytes are moved forward to make room for the copied parameter, but there is no explicit check that curr_full_len fits in scanner->buffer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/libzscanner/functions.c","function":"svcb_sort","line":877,"var":"param_pos","code":"memcpy(param_pos, scanner->buffer, curr_full_len);","note":"The copied parameter is written back into the gap, completing the reordering step that can overflow the temporary buffer when the parameter is too large."}
